title: Object Stamp Flow - extract an object from one image, place it into another
description: Dev-gated Flow: stamp an object taken from one image onto another. Step 0 takes both images, a text field names the object (SAM3 text segment), a kind:'box' step marks where it goes on the target, and a denoise slider drives the Krea2 detail pass that blends it. ONE dispatch - no new step kind, no new component, no mid-flow generation. Design: brief.md. Split out of the MPI-562 brainstorm 2026-08-21.
acceptance: A new dev-gated Flow in flowsRegistry.js takes two image inputs: the image to stamp ONTO (image1) and the image to extract FROM (image2)
A kind:'fields' step carries one text field naming the object to extract, feeding a SAM3 text-segment branch in the workflow
A kind:'box' step on image1 reports where the object goes, bound to an injection param - NO new step kind and NO new UI component
The extracted cutout is fitted INSIDE that box preserving its aspect ratio, never stretched to fill it
A denoise slider controls the Krea2 detail pass that blends the placement, with a MEASURED default rather than a guessed one
The flow runs as ONE dispatch - no mid-flow generation and no preview round trip
A named object that is not present in image2 fails legibly, rather than returning the untouched target with no explanation
If the aspect-fit fork needs a new node, it ships through /mpi-nodes-sync and is PINNED in dev_configs/node_lock.json - committed but unpinned is not shipped
Live-run and reuse both pass per docs/playbooks/add-flow/05-verify.md
Tile still and hero clip ship via /mpi-flow-graphics
